name: Sahachara Baladi Kashayam

sections.overview: Sahachara Baladi Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Sahachara Baladi Kashayam is an undiluted decoction is made from herbs, which comprise of water soluble active principles.
sections.ingredients:
Vasa ( Adhatoda vasica ) 
 Rasna ( Pluchea lanceolata ) 
 Dried ginger ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Sahachara ( Strobilanthes ciliatus ) 
 Castor ( Ricinus communis ) 
 Dusparsa ( Tragia involucrata ) 
 Ativisha ( Aconitum heterophyllum ) 
 Sati ( Kaempferia galanga l) 
 Devadaru ( Cedrus deodara ) 
 Bala ( Sida cordifolia ) 
 Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) 
 Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) 
 Ikshura ( Hygrophila auriculata ) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and crush all the ingredients to a coarse powder. Add this powder to water and boil it till it reduces to 1/4th of its volume. Let it cool down and filter it. Transfer the filtrate to a tinted glass bottle. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sahachara Baladi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to manage the vata disorders. This herbal decoction is prepared by the combination of herbs which comprise the anti-inflammatory properties. Use of this medicine is quite good to manage the inflammatory conditions in body. It is very helpful medicine to manage the various problems like joint pain, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis etc. Anti-inflammatory and anti-arthritic action of this medicine helps to alleviate the various symptoms like joint pain, morning stiffness, inflammation etc. This medicine is quite good for joints problems and also improves the blood circulation in the affected areas. Besides of this, it is good medicine for various other inflammatory conditions like backache, general body pains and debility etc.
sections.indications:
Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Numbness 
 Back ache 
 Vata doshas
sections.dosage: Consume 5 to 15 ml and dilute it with 15 to 30 ml of water.
sections.contraindications:
There are no reported side effects of this formulation. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

 Introduction

 Bala ( Sida cordifolia ) 
 Shatavari ( Asparagus racemosus ) 
 Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) 
 Ikshura ( Hygrophila auriculata ) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and crush all the ingredients to a coarse powder. Add this powder to water and boil it till it reduces to 1/4th of its volume. Let it cool down and filter it. Transfer the filtrate to a tinted glass bottle. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Sahachara Baladi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine meant to manage the vata disorders. This herbal decoction is prepared by the combination of herbs which comprise the anti-inflammatory properties. Use of this medicine is quite good to manage the inflammatory conditions in body. It is very helpful medicine to manage the various problems like joint pain, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis etc. Anti-inflammatory and anti-arthritic action of this medicine helps to alleviate the various symptoms like joint pain, morning stiffness, inflammation etc. This medicine is quite good for joints problems and also improves the blood circulation in the affected areas. Besides of this, it is good medicine for various other inflammatory conditions like backache, general body pains and debility etc. 
 Indications 
 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Numbness
